name: Minazuki Kanade
source:
A veteran officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police. She is always gentle and kind to everyone, acting as if she were an elder sister or mother in front of the officers and listening to their concerns. As a result, the second division's junior officers regard her as a big sister or mother. She cherishes [url=https://vndb.org/c99107]Kotetsu[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c99108]Isana[/url] as if they were her little sisters. Her hobby is serving black tea, delectable meals, and those kinds of things to everyone.

Since the old days, Kanade has witnessed the perseverance of the second division chief, [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]Ayato[/url], at his side. At work, she always devotedly support him. At the same time, she wants to alleviate his fatigue and pamper him. All officers, who manage logistical work, are clothed in maid uniforms. Actually, there is a reason for this.

As a Special Holder, she has some sort of comprehension power. It consists of cybernetic psychometry, specializing in electronic information. Kanade uses an information terminal. When she joins a computer network, she can quickly analyze information. When it comes to electrical locking devices, she can find a way to manipulate them simply by touching them.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.propeller-game.com/product/yuzuriha/chara03.html]official site[/url]]
